name: Bacon-Wrapped Mini Meatloaves with Roasted Asparagus & Bell Pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F). Arrange racks in the upper, middle, and lower positions.
Cut bacon in half crosswise and place on a plate.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl along with beef, Dijon, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using 2 generous tablespoons per meatloaf, form the beef mixture into 24 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long. Wrap each meatloaf with bacon and transfer, seam-side down, to a large baking sheet pan.
Place baking sheet on the top rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until meatloaves are just cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; divide spears between two baking sheets.

Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips and add to the baking sheets with the asparagus. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets on the lower racks of the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the meatloaves are done, change oven to broil on high; broil until bacon is crisp, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide meatloaves and veggies between plates; enjoy!
